old_domain: 'Lady of Sustenance' - the feminine aspect of the supreme creator-duality, paired with Tonacatecuhtli in Omeyocan

name: Tonantzin
old_domain: 'Our Revered Mother' - collective title-aspect of the mother-goddess complex; famously the pre-Conquest goddess of Tepeyac, on whose shrine the Basilica of Guadalupe was built

name: Tonatiuh
old_domain: 'He Goes Forth Shining' - the sun, specifically the fifth sun of the present age; principal solar-deity; warrior-paradise; sun who demands blood-sacrifice to continue his daily journey

name: Tuisto
old_domain: earth-born primordial god of the continental Germanic peoples, named by Tacitus as the origin of the Germanic nation

name: Tyche
old_domain: fortune, luck, chance - both good and bad; personification of how things 'fall out'; daughter of Oceanus

name: Typhon
old_domain: monstrous storm-serpent; last child of Gaia and Tartarus; gravest threat ever faced by Zeus; father of many other monsters by Echidna

name: Utnapishtim
old_domain: flood-survival, immortality granted, far-distant land of Dilmun-equivalent, witness of the antediluvian world

name: Utu
old_domain: sun, justice, oath, illumination of hidden truths, rising-up over Mount Mashu, judge of the netherworld in his nightly transit, defender of travellers

name: Vairocana
old_domain: cosmic Buddha; 'Illuminator'; in many Mahayana and all Vajrayana systems the central or primordial Buddha, embodiment of the Dharmakaya

name: Vaisravana
old_domain: chief of the Four Heavenly Kings; guardian of the north; god of wealth; protector of the Dharma and of those who hear it

name: Vajrapani
old_domain: bodhisattva of the Buddha's power and protective energy; wielder of the vajra; one of the earliest and most important protective bodhisattvas

name: Vertumnus
old_domain: seasonal changes, harvest, garden-fruit-ripening; metamorphosis; Etruscan god imported to Rome; husband of Pomona

name: Vucub Caquix
old_domain: 'Seven Macaw' of the Popol Vuh; a vain bird-monster who in the time before the true sun set himself up as a false sun and moon; brought down by the Hero Twins

name: Vucub-Came
old_domain: 'Seven Death'; with Hun-Came, one of the two highest lords of Xibalba, the K'iche' Maya underworld; defeated by the Hero Twins

name: Vulcan
old_domain: fire, forge, metalworking; identified with Hephaestus; god of the Comitium and the original Roman state-fire

name: Xbalanque
old_domain: one of the K'iche' Maya Hero Twins of the Popol Vuh; with his twin Hunahpu, conqueror of the lords of Xibalba; finally raised to become the moon

name: Xiwangmu
old_domain: the Queen Mother of the West; goddess of immortality, life, and the western paradise of Mount Kunlun; keeper of the peaches of immortality; one of the most ancient and important Chinese deities

name: YHWH
old_domain: covenant deity of Israel, creator of heaven and earth, holy, jealous, just, merciful, the Tetragrammaton

name: Yaldabaoth
old_domain: demiurge of the Gnostic systems; ignorant, arrogant lower power - malformed offspring of Sophia - who fashions the flawed material cosmos and falsely proclaims himself the only god; also called Saklas and Samael

name: Yama
old_domain: lord of death and judge of the dead in Buddhist cosmology; ruler of the hell-realms; the Buddhist development of the Vedic/Hindu Yama

name: Yandi
old_domain: the Yan Emperor; one of the early sage-rulers; often identified with Shennong; defeated by the Yellow Emperor at Banquan; co-ancestor of the Chinese people

name: Yao
old_domain: one of the great sage-kings; model of the virtuous ruler; famous for abdicating the throne to the worthy Shun rather than his own son

name: Ymir
old_domain: primordial giant, first being from the chaos-gap, cosmos-body - from whose dismembered form the world is made

name: Yu the Great
old_domain: legendary controller of the Great Flood; founder of the Xia dynasty; last of the sage-kings; model of the selfless tireless ruler

name: Yum Kaax
old_domain: the Yucatec Maya god of the wild vegetation, forest, and especially of maize as a crop and of agriculture; youthful Maize God

name: Zao Jun
old_domain: the Kitchen God / Stove God; household deity who watches over the family from his place above the hearth and reports their conduct to the Jade Emperor at the New Year; most domestically-intimate of Chinese deities

name: Zhongli Quan
old_domain: one of the Eight Immortals, often regarded as the eldest and most senior; immortal who initiated Lu Dongbin; master of the elixir of life and the fan that revives the dead
